platform.name: Arms License Management System
platform.description: A comprehensive digital platform for managing the complete arms licensing ecosystem through configurable workflows, role-based approvals, compliance monitoring, audit tracking, and lifecycle management.

hero.title: Secure, Transparent & Workflow-Driven Arms License Governance
hero.subtitle: A comprehensive digital platform for managing the complete arms licensing ecosystem through configurable workflows, role-based approvals, compliance monitoring, audit tracking, and lifecycle management.

serviceModules.title: Fresh Application
serviceModules.description: Apply for a new arms license through a structured digital form with personal details, address, occupation, criminal history, biometric data, and document uploads — all validated in real time.

serviceModules.title: License Renewal
serviceModules.description: Renew existing licenses with a streamlined process that pre-fills approved application data, supports license merging, and maintains complete audit history across renewals.

serviceModules.title: License Transfer
serviceModules.description: Facilitate ownership and authority transfers through a configurable workflow that ensures proper verification, approval, and documentation at every transfer stage.

serviceModules.title: License Cancellation
serviceModules.description: Process license cancellations with proper authorization chain, reason documentation, and automatic archival of all related records for future reference.

workflowGovernance.title: Workflow Governance
workflowGovernance.description: A configurable multi-level approval system that ensures transparency, accountability, and compliance at every step of the licensing process.
highlights: Role Mapping — Assign specific roles to each workflow step
Action Mapping — Define permissible actions per role (Forward, Approve, Reject, Return)
Status Tracking — Real-time status codes track every transition
Multi-Level Approval Chain — Up to 7 authority tiers
Audit History — Immutable action logs with timestamps
Workflow Transparency — Complete visibility into process stage

adminControlCenter.title: Administrative Control Center
adminControlCenter.description: The backbone of the ALMS platform — comprehensive administrative tools for managing the entire governance ecosystem.

features.title: User Management
features.description: Create, update, and manage users with role assignments, location hierarchy mapping, and activity status control.

features.title: Role Management
features.description: Define and configure roles with granular permissions across 3 categories — complete CRUD with soft-delete capability.

features.title: Workflow Configuration
features.description: Configure status transitions between roles using PostgreSQL array-based next role configuration with validation.

features.title: Flow Mapping
features.description: Visual workflow designer with DFS-based circular dependency detection and comprehensive role connection mapping.

features.title: Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Real-time statistics and trends with charts for applications by week, role load distribution, and status breakdowns.

features.title: Reports System
features.description: Exportable reports for oversight with filtering by date range, status, role, and location hierarchy.

features.title: Audit Trails
features.description: Complete action history with timestamps, user tracking, and merge audit logs for all system activities.

features.title: Master Data Management
features.description: Manage locations (State/District/Zone/Division/Police Station), weapon types, document types, and other reference data.

compliance.title: Compliance & Verification Framework
compliance.description: Multi-layered verification and compliance checks ensuring only eligible applicants receive licenses through thorough background validation.

lifecycle.title: Complete License Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: End-to-end lifecycle management from initial application through final disposition — every stage tracked, audited, and transparent.

stages.description: Submit personal details, address, occupation information, criminal history declaration, and required documents.
Document verification, criminal history checks, identity validation, and initial eligibility assessment.
Biometric capture (signature, iris, photograph), ground report generation, and field-level verification by local authorities.
Multi-level workflow approvals through SHO, ACP, DCP, JTCP, CP, and Arms Superintendent with configurable authority chains.
FLAF generation, license number assignment, QR code generation, and official issuance documentation.
Continuous license monitoring, renewal notifications, compliance tracking, and activity logging throughout license validity.
Pre-filled renewal process with approved application data, license merge system, and streamlined re-verification workflow.
Authority transfer workflow with verification, documentation, and approval chain for ownership or jurisdictional changes.
License cancellation with proper authorization, reason documentation, evidence archival, and final disposition recording.

security.title: Security & Governance
security.description: Enterprise-grade security infrastructure protecting sensitive data with multiple layers of access control, encryption, and audit capabilities.

features.title: RBAC
features.description: Fine-grained Role-Based Access Control with 26 permissions across all system modules.

features.title: JWT Authentication
features.description: Secure token-based authentication with automatic refresh and session management.

features.title: Audit Logging
features.description: Immutable timestamps and complete action history for every system operation.

features.title: Encrypted Storage
features.description: AES-256 encryption for sensitive documents and personally identifiable information at rest.

features.title: Document Security
features.description: Encrypted file storage with access control, version tracking, and secure download URLs.

features.title: Biometric Protection
features.description: Encrypted storage and secure transmission for biometric data including signatures, iris scans, and photographs.

features.title: Soft Delete Strategy
features.description: Data preservation with soft-delete patterns ensuring no permanent data loss and complete recovery capability.

features.title: Activity Tracking
features.description: Real-time monitoring of all user activities with detailed logs for security analysis and compliance.

footer.securityNotice: All activities are monitored and audited for security and compliance purposes.
